{{Top|leg}}
'''Wobble balls''' were used in the [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Repulsorlift/Legends|Repulsors]] could levitate them off the floor, and during a sparring match a Jedi could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pluck]] it out of the air, and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Throw|hurl]] it at someone. This would teach a Jedi to be more focused, and to avoid distractions during combat. A wobble ball was heavy enough to knock a grown man down when thrown with the Force. Wobble balls were able to be cut in half with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].

[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used some wobble balls in the [[New Jedi Temple]]'s sparring arena against his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], when he was trying to see how well [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] was teaching him to defend himself.
